payload.body: You tend to build the alternate life in saved posts, playlists, private fantasies, or long conversations that never become a decision. Imagination keeps the desire available while protecting you from the consequences of naming it. This often comes from learning that the actual want was unrealistic, embarrassing, or disruptive. Choose one real action that belongs to the desire rather than another way to picture it.
payload.astroHint: Lilith conjunct Neptune can make a forbidden desire easier to imagine than to act on directly.
